title: NEPA Categorical Exclusions (CATEX) Catalogue
description: The federal Categorical Exclusion (CATEX) catalogue published by the Permitting Innovation Center. CATEXs are classes of actions that normally do not require further environmental review under NEPA (42 U.S.C. §§ 4321 et seq.) because they have been found not to have a significant effect on the environment, individually or cumulatively. This contract governs the 2,105 records spanning 78 federal agency units (AFRH, CPSC, DC, DHS, …).

table:columns.name: id
table:columns.description: Database id (catalog-internal integer). Stable across releases; do not reuse.

table:columns.name: structuredId
table:columns.description: Hierarchical structured identifier, e.g. `AFRH--1-1-1`. Encodes the agency unit, section, and clause number.

table:columns.name: unit
table:columns.description: Agency unit code (e.g. `AFRH`, `CPSC`, `DHS`, `DHS - CBP`, `DOD - DA`). One catalogue release typically contains records for 78 distinct units.

table:columns.name: longUnit
table:columns.description: Long-form agency unit name (e.g. `Armed Forces Retirement Home`, `Federal Emergency Management Agency`).

table:columns.name: unitOrder
table:columns.description: Display/sort order for the unit within the catalogue UI.

table:columns.name: origin
table:columns.description: Human-readable origin list (e.g. `Bureau of Indian Affairs's Categorical Exclusions`).

table:columns.name: originUrl
table:columns.description: Canonical URL to the published CFR / eCFR source list (e.g. `https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-38/chapter-II/part-200#Appendix-A-to-Part-200`). Natural join key with `Project.leadAgency` in the pic-standards subgraph.

table:columns.name: context
table:columns.description: Section heading under which the exclusion is catalogued (e.g. `A.3 CATEXs—Requires No Documentation`).

table:columns.name: additionalContext
table:columns.description: Free-text body of the section heading describing the class of exclusions.

table:columns.name: circumstances
table:columns.description: Extraordinary-circumstances clause that must be considered before applying the exclusion. Often `Not Catalogued`.

table:columns.name: exclusion
table:columns.description: Verbatim exclusion text, including the leading letter/number clause (e.g. `(a) Granting a lease (i.e., outlease), an easement, license, permit (i.e., licenses to Federal entities), or other arrangements...`).
